content:
Former Apple retail SVP Ron Johnson joins the Overtime show to talk about his new book, Shop Different: How Retail Revealed Apple's Genius. Johnson looks back on the early days of the Apple Store, working with Steve Jobs, the launch of the original iPhone, why he left Apple to become CEO of JCPenney, his thoughts on the current state of Apple retail, and of course his take on the iPhone Duo.

This episode is sponsored by Bitwarden: A free virtual Open Source Security Summit is happening on September 17 — sign up now to hear from and engage with cybersecurity leaders including David Sanger and Joseph Menn; plus, Bitwarden offers a trusted open-source solution for managing passwords, passkeys, and secrets, with end-to-end encryption and seamless autofill across all your devices.

9to5Mac Overtime is a weekly video-first podcast exploring the quirky and interesting observations within the Apple ecosystem, hosted by 9to5Mac's Fernando Silva and Jeff Benjamin. Subscribe to Overtime on Apple Podcasts and our YouTube channel for more.
